## Introduction

This R Markdown file presents an analysis of cybersecurity incidents using a sample dataset and custom R functions developed in the `Cybersecurity` package. The main tasks include filtering incidents by type, summarizing incident data, and visualizing attack trends over time.

---

## Load Libraries and Dataset

We begin by loading the required packages and the sample dataset.

```{r load-data, message=FALSE}
# Load required packages
library(Cybersecurity)
library(ggplot2)

# Load and inspect the data
df <- read.csv("sample_incidents.csv")
df$Date <- as.Date(df$Date, format = "%Y-%m-%d")

head(df)
# Filter for malware incidents
filtered_df <- filter_by_type(df, "malware")

# Display the filtered results
filtered_df

# Summarize the dataset
summary_stats <- summarize_incidents(df)
summary_stats

# Plot attack trends
plot_attack_trends(df)
